maru_1.speaker: MARU
maru_1.text: Biribel. Vasile sent you. Of course he did.

maru_2.speaker: BIRIBEL
maru_2.text: He wants you brought in. Breathing, he says.

maru_3.speaker: MARU
maru_3.text: Breathing in a Guard cell. Balaceanu was breathing too, last week.

maru_4.speaker: BIRIBEL
maru_4.text: Then we don't go to the cell. Is there another way out?

maru_5.speaker: MARU
maru_5.text: Basement. The old tunnel runs to the river. If we live long enough to reach it.

maru_6.speaker: SYSTEM
maru_6.text: [ Engines outside. Boots on the loading bay. The Guard is here. ]
